visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a mirror selfie. A young woman with long brown hair wears a blue Celine cap, a black and white checkered blazer over a dark grey denim jumpsuit. She holds a black phone and a green wallet. The background is a brightly lit luxury boutique with clothing racks and framed art on the wall. (2) The scene cuts to a product shot. A Louis Vuitton Speedy bag in white and grey monogram sits on a textured grey ottoman. In the background, there are illuminated shelves displaying various styles of men's shoes and a blue patterned rug on the floor. (3) The view shifts to a private lounge area. A vibrant yellow designer armchair sits beside a glass-topped trunk coffee table. On a glass shelf in the background, a light blue handbag is displayed next to another LV trunk. The lighting is warm and focused. (4) A close-up shot of clothing racks reveals several high-end garments, including a black patterned dress, a cream-colored vest, and white blouses hanging on metal rails. The background wall is a neutral beige, and the overall lighting is bright studio-style. (5) The woman appears in a selfie mid-shot, looking directly at the lens with a slightly concerned or tired facial expression. She is in the same store environment, wearing the cap and blazer seen previously. Large yellow text blocks cover the bottom half of the frame. (6) The camera focuses back on the white LV bag, now placed on top of the large branded trunk table in the lounge. The scene captures the luxury details of the room, including the gold-tone hardware on the trunk and the soft ambient lighting. (7) A wider shot of the private shopping room shows more luxury items on shelves, including classic brown monogram trunks. The interior design is minimalist yet expensive, with textured walls and soft, recessed lighting highlighting the merchandise. (8) The final shot shows the white LV bag in the foreground, with three quilted Chanel bags (pink, patterned, black) lined up behind it on a shelf. A colorful variety text sticker is placed at the bottom, and the lighting remains bright and consistent.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 來講一件在日本LV的瞎事. (2) [Subtitle]: 我真的沒有買什麼貴重物品 買這顆而已. (3) [Subtitle]: 我只是買了普通的包 結帳時就被帶進小黑屋 這我第一次進LV小黑屋🤣. (4) [Subtitle]: 裡面衣服就是這些 也蠻無聊的😏 後來他說結帳好了 帶我去退稅！ / 得到百貨樓上去退 就跑了一趟 退完了又回到小黑屋等東西. (5) [Variety]: 接著店員突然說 不好意思他結帳錯價格了！ 要重新刷一次，然後作廢原本的 然後他還請主管進來簽核 也表達不好意思 這樣退稅還要再跑一次 雖然無奈我也只好配合🫠🫠🫠. (6) [Subtitle]: 於是整個流程又跑了一次 我又去跑了一次退稅 回到店裡又去小黑屋等 / 最後 終於給了我一大袋 裡面是很大的LV紙盒 然後送我到樓梯口. (7) [Subtitle]: 才走幾步路，我就覺得袋子怎麼這麼輕啊？ 想說檢查一下紙盒裡面 結果裡面沒有任何東西😱😱 超級傻眼😳 立刻回去跟他說！ 他嚇一，他主管更傻眼！ 可能想說特這單到底怎麼回事⋯⋯ 他們瘋狂道歉 然後跪跑去錢包再包在耶😂. (8) [Subtitle]: 前幾天看到有人也在日本買皮夾(夾牌 回到飯店才發現紙盒裡面沒東西🥲 真的會瘋掉！！ 建議大家真的還是 離開前檢查一下！！. (9) [Subtitle]: 虛驚一場 幸好我們還是有把它帶回國！ 這咖是出發帶去的.
